sylph_db.help_text: Path to a pre-built Sylph database (.syldb).

sylph_tax_metadata.help_text: Path to the sylph-tax metadata TSV to use for taxprof.

taxonomic_rank.help_text: Taxonomic rank by which to group references. Choices: domain, kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species.

pool_latin_taxa.help_text: Advanced option. Ignores alphabet suffixes of GTDB divisions of latin-name taxa, thus pooling those subdivisions together. Not recommended to change unless the effects on output are understood; see docs for more info.

genome_id_to_file.help_text: File from which to extract genome paths based on genome identifiers.
